description: This file contains unit tests for the PimCsvDataImport class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CSV import functionality related to employee data such as nationality, country, and employee details.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportTest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for verifying the functionality of the PimCsvDataImport class, including data import success scenarios, validation of employee data fields, and handling duplicate employee IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, truncates specific tables, and creates a new instance of PimCsvDataImport.

methods.name: testGetNationalityService
methods.description: Verifies that getNationalityService returns an instance of NationalityService.

methods.name: testGetCountryService
methods.description: Verifies that getCountryService returns an instance of CountryService, mocking the service retrieval.

methods.name: testIsValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks the validity of phone number strings.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessful
methods.description: Tests successful import of employee data, including nationality, country, and province lookup and entity creation.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessfulWhenGenderValueChanges
methods.description: Tests import with gender value as 'Female', ensuring proper handling and persistence.

methods.name: testImportWhenFirstNameNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that import fails when the first name field is empty.

methods.name: testImportWhenLastNameNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that import fails when the last name field is empty.

methods.name: testImportWhenEmployeeIdDuplicated
methods.description: Checks behavior when importing employees with duplicate employee IDs, ensuring duplicates are not persisted multiple times.
